posts.caption:
What racing wheel to buy a teenager who has a PS5: three setups that work with the console you already have, with what to order, what each costs, the floor it takes and how loud it is.

With the TV you have: Couch to Track $439 (wheel stand + Thrustmaster T248R), Midnight Rookie $519 (folding cockpit + Logitech G923), Rosso GT $1,748 (frame, seat, Fanatec Gran Turismo DD Pro, load-cell pedals).

Every part, the floor plans and a 3D view: https://roomracer.com/gifts/ps5-racing-wheel?src=yt-long

Prices are our estimates of typical US prices, not a store's price; the price at checkout is the one that counts. Noise lines come from how each wheel base is built, not from hands-on tests. Synthetic voice. We earn from qualifying purchases. #ps5 #simracing #giftideas

scenes.title: What racing wheel do we buy a teen with a PS5?
scenes.sub: Three setups, what to order, and the totals.
scenes.say: What racing wheel should you buy a teenager who already has a PS5? Here are three setups that work with the console you have. For each one: exactly what to order, what it costs, how much floor it takes, and how loud it is.

scenes.title: Three setups, with the TV you have

items.name: Couch to Track
items.line: Wheel stand in front of the TV. Folds away.
items.say: Couch to Track, about four thirty-nine. A wheel stand in front of the living-room TV, and it folds behind the sofa.

items.name: Midnight Rookie
items.line: Cockpit with its own seat. Folds flat.
items.say: Midnight Rookie, about five nineteen. A cockpit with its own seat, for a bedroom, and the seat folds flat.

items.name: Rosso GT
items.say: Rosso GT, about seventeen forty-eight. A frame, a racing seat and a direct-drive wheel, for a teen who already loves Gran Turismo.

scenes.note: Our estimates of typical US prices, not a store's.
scenes.outro: Every price here is our estimate of the typical US price. The price at checkout is the one that counts. Let's go through them one by one.

scenes.title: 1 · Couch to Track

items.label: Wheel stand
items.name: Next Level Racing Wheel Stand Lite
items.say: First, a wheel stand: the Next Level Racing Wheel Stand Lite, about one thirty-nine.

items.label: Wheel and pedals, in one box
items.name: Thrustmaster T248R (PlayStation/PC)
items.say: Then the wheel: a Thrustmaster T two forty-eight R, about three hundred. The wheel rim and the pedals come in the same box.

items.label: Console and screen
items.name: The PS5 and TV you have
items.say: And the PS5 and the TV you already have.

scenes.outro: That's four thirty-nine. If you want a new fifty-five inch TV with it, the page has that version at ten thirty-eight.

scenes.title: Couch to Track in the living room

items.caption: Stand · 1′10″ × 2′4″
items.detail: In front of the sofa. Folds behind it after.
items.say: The stand takes about one foot ten by two foot four, in front of the sofa, and the sofa is the seat. When they're done, it folds away behind it.

items.v: Thrustmaster makes the T248R for PS5
items.say: Does it work with the PS5? Thrustmaster makes the T two forty-eight R for PlayStation 5, and the page has our compatibility check for every part.
It's belt-driven, so it hums softly. Quieter than a gear wheel.

items.v: 2 next to the PS5: wheel base and TV
items.say: It needs two outlets next to the PS5: the wheel base and the TV.

scenes.title: 2 · Midnight Rookie

items.label: Cockpit with seat
items.name: Playseat Challenge X - Logitech G Edition
items.say: Setup two is for a bedroom. A Playseat Challenge X, the Logitech G edition, about two eighty-nine. It's a cockpit with its own seat.

items.label: Wheel and pedals, in one box
items.name: Logitech G923 TRUEFORCE (PlayStation/PC)
items.say: And a Logitech G nine twenty-three, the PlayStation version, about two thirty, with the pedals in the box.

scenes.note: With its own 27-inch monitor and stand: $907.
scenes.outro: That's five nineteen with your TV. With its own twenty-seven inch monitor and a stand, it's nine oh seven.

items.caption: Monitor stand · 2′7″ × 2′4″
items.detail: Only if it gets its own screen.
items.say: If it gets its own screen, the monitor stand takes about two foot seven by two foot four.

items.caption: Cockpit · 2′ × 4′7″
items.say: The cockpit is about two feet by four foot seven, right behind it. When they're done, the seat folds flat.

items.v: Logitech makes this G923 for PS5
items.say: Logitech makes this G nine twenty-three for PlayStation 5.

items.v: Gear-driven: the gears whir and click
items.say: It's gear-driven, so you'll hear the gears whir and click when the wheel pushes back. Fine in a bedroom with the door shut. Noticeable in a quiet house late at night.

items.v: A rug or foam mat under the pedals
items.say: Living over someone? A rug or a foam mat under the pedals takes most of the knock.

scenes.title: 3 · Rosso GT

items.label: Frame
items.name: Sim-Lab GT1 Evo (frame only)
items.say: Setup three is the serious one. A Sim-Lab GT1 Evo frame, about four forty-nine.

items.label: Seat
items.name: Sparco R100 Reclining Seat
items.say: A Sparco R one hundred seat, three seventy-nine.

items.label: Direct drive, wheel in the box
items.name: Fanatec Gran Turismo DD Pro (5 Nm bundle)
items.say: The Fanatec Gran Turismo D D Pro, about seven hundred, a hundred less than at our previous price check. Its steering wheel is in the box.

items.label: Load-cell pedals
items.name: Fanatec CSL Pedals with Load Cell Kit
items.say: And Fanatec's load-cell pedals, about two twenty.

scenes.note: With a 42-inch OLED TV and its stand: $2,948.
scenes.outro: That's seventeen forty-eight with your TV. With a forty-two inch OLED and a stand, twenty-nine forty-eight.

items.caption: TV stand · 2′11″ × 2′4″
items.say: With its own TV, the stand takes about two foot eleven by two foot four.

items.caption: Frame · 1′11″ × 4′5″
items.detail: It stays set up. Give it a corner.
items.say: The frame is about one foot eleven by four foot five. It doesn't fold, so give it a corner it can keep.

items.v: Fanatec makes the GT DD Pro for PS5
items.say: Fanatec makes the Gran Turismo D D Pro for PlayStation 5.

items.v: Direct drive: the motor is close to silent
items.say: Direct drive is close to silent. What you hear is the pedals, and a thump through the floor on hard braking.
All three setups run Gran Turismo 7, Assetto Corsa Competizione and Assetto Corsa on the PS5.

items.v: No. All three use the one you have.
items.say: Is a PS5 included? No. All three use the console you have.

items.k: Do we need a new TV?
items.say: Do you need a new TV? No. With yours, it's four thirty-nine, five nineteen, or seventeen forty-eight.

items.v: Wheel and pedals to the base, base to the PS5
items.say: Setting it up: the wheel and pedals plug into the wheel base, and the wheel base plugs into the PS5.
And order by Friday, December eleventh. That's our suggestion, not a carrier's deadline: the boxes are big, and you'll want a weekend to build it before the twenty-fifth.
